content.text:
Done. `src/app/overlay/[token]/OverlayClient.tsx`.

**Win (`confetti` preset)** — two layers now:
- 4 corner cannons, 18 bits each, launched inward on ease-out then gravity-dropped off-frame (`--dx`/`--dy` per bit, `burst` keyframe).
- 44 falling bits with lateral sway + spin, mixed 6-color palette, mixed shapes (circles/rects).

**Loss (`glitch` preset)** — got its own set:
- One shudder of the whole layer on entry.
- Radial vignette closing in from the edges.
- 34 ash/ember specks drifting down (accent-colored every 4th).

Colors/geometry all generated in JS, never from user input — no new injection surface, no new dep.

skipped: per-user confetti color config, `prefers-reduced-motion` — add when someone asks (OBS has no reader).

Note: win `durationMs` default is 4000ms; fall layer runs to ~4.5s so tail bits fade out mid-flight. Bump `win.defaults.durationMs` to 5500 in `src/lib/eventTypes.ts` if you want the full fall to land.
